comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district signs. Shown as an in-world sign + HUD popup when the car enters proximity. Coordinates are real lat/lon projected into world space at runtime (same pipeline as landmarks.json). route_order follows the Airport→Ochi direction. Entries marked needs_owner_review:true are best-effort from OSM/map research — the owner's lived knowledge is authoritative and should override them.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow Palisadoes peninsula — sea on both sides; coconut trees line the road

communities.name: Port Royal
communities.note: Historic former pirate capital; signposted from the Palisadoes road; off-route to the south

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Roundabout community at the end of the Palisadoes strip; gateway into Kingston

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Industrial community along Windward Road near the Rockfort Mineral Bath

communities.name: Rollington Town
communities.note: East Kingston community along Windward Road

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Hillside community above Mountain View Avenue; known for its Rasta traditions

communities.name: Mountain View
communities.note: Community and avenue in east Kingston

communities.name: Vineyard Town
communities.note: Residential community between Mountain View and Cross Roads

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major Kingston junction where Trafalgar Road meets South Camp Road

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's financial and business district; towers, hotels, Emancipation Park

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The beating heart of uptown Kingston — transport hub, clock tower, market

communities.name: Olympic Gardens
communities.note: Kingston community near Hagley Park Road

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Former capital of Jamaica; historic Georgian square, cathedrals and old iron bridge

communities.name: Sligoville
communities.note: Mountain community on the road between Spanish Town and Bog Walk

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Community in the dramatic Rio Cobre gorge; gateway to the mountains

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: "Linstead Market" — the famous folk song; bustling market town in the Rio Cobre valley

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Small town on the Linstead–Moneague road; alumina plant nearby

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Crossroads village in the St. Ann highlands; cool air and sweeping views

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: World-famous roadside cookshop strip — best jerk chicken on the island

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: A steep gorge road once used as a riverbed; walls covered in ferns and bamboo

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Jamaica's tourist capital on the north coast; Dunn's River Falls, cruise ships, resort town
